description: An unbalanced Wheatstone bridge read from two files: nodes.csv (each node's id, starting voltage and whether it is held) and wires.csv (each wire's ends and conductance). A current flows along each wire from its higher end; every free node charges a small capacitance until the currents into it balance, which is Kirchhoff's solution: then the power the held nodes supply equals the power the wires dissipate.
